obligations.statement: The product must provide a surface that the user's foot can press to actuate the signal.
derivation_premises: A foot pressing on a pedal requires an accessible surface to transmit force.

obligations.statement: The product must transmit the foot's press to the machine as a signal.
derivation_premises: A signal must be generated by a mechanical action that reaches the machine.

obligations.statement: The product must return to a defined resting position automatically when the foot is removed.
derivation_premises: A return to a resting position requires a restoring mechanism that acts when no external force is applied.

obligations.statement: The product must resist displacement due to a sideways brush while remaining operable by the foot.
derivation_premises: If a body is not constrained against a lateral force, it may move, so the product must have a constraint to prevent such movement.

obligations.statement: The product must be supported by the workbench during operation, anchoring it against reaction forces.
derivation_premises: A product resting on a surface must have a support that resists the forces it exerts.

obligations.statement: The product must include a mechanism to convert the foot's linear press into a signal that can be sent to the machine.
derivation_premises: A press must be transformed into a signal, requiring a conversion mechanism.

obligations.statement: The product must include a mechanism to automatically return the pedal to its resting position.
derivation_premises: Automatic return requires a return mechanism, such as a spring or gravity.

obligations.statement: The product must include a mechanism to prevent sideways movement while still allowing the pressing motion.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that allows vertical motion but resists lateral motion must have a constraint that permits one and blocks the other.

obligations.statement: The product's moving parts must maintain a defined path of motion for the pedal during press and release.
derivation_premises: To press and release, the pedal must have a guided motion to avoid misalignment.

obligations.statement: The product must have a defined resting position that is stable and from which pressing is possible.
derivation_premises: A resting position must exist and be reachable after release.

obligations.statement: The product's base must be stable enough to resist tipping or sliding during foot operation.
derivation_premises: Forces from pressing and brushing must be reacted without moving the product.

obligations.statement: The product must accommodate the foot's reach and operation without requiring the foot to move from its natural position.
derivation_premises: The foot must be able to press the pedal without excessive reach.

candidates.summary: A spring-loaded lever pedal that pivots on a hinge

evidence_route_verdict.note: A lever can transmit force; spring return and hinge provide return and lateral stability.

candidates.summary: A spring-loaded pedal that slides vertically in a guide

evidence_route_verdict.note: Slider-crank converts linear motion; spring return for return; guide provides lateral stability.

candidates.summary: A pedal connected to a rotating cam that sends a signal when pressed

evidence_route_verdict.note: Cam converts press to signal; return spring and cam profile allow return; cam provides lateral constraint.

alternatives: no change in position that would affect function

unresolved.decision: Which candidate mechanism to select for the pedal
unresolved.why_open: All candidates address the same obligations and evidence routes are available for all; no discriminating information exists.

assumptions.statement: The pedal's lateral displacement is measured at the point where the brush contacts it.
assumptions.why: To interpret REQ-0003, we assume the relevant point is the contact point.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the requirement refers to the whole pedal moving.

assumptions.statement: The pedal is operated by a bare or normal shoe.
assumptions.why: The requirement does not specify footwear; assume typical operation.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If a specific footwear type is required.

assumptions.statement: The machine's signal is triggered by a switch that can be engaged by any of the candidate mechanisms.
assumptions.why: The requirement only says a signal is sent, not the type of switch.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If a specific switch type is required that only certain mechanisms can actuate.
